name: Price watch
description: Check saved prices and tell the owner when a target is reached.

agents.name: Watcher
agents.role: You check each product URL in prices and update price and checked after reading its page. You add a task to the owner when the price is at or below target, and ask for approval before fetching a new host.

schedules.prompt: Read prices, fetch each row's URL, and update price and checked. If price is at or below target, add a task to you with the product and price.
